name: CoMoral
description: CoMoral is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate large language models' ability to detect commonsense contradictions embedded within moral dilemmas, highlighting the models' tendency to prioritize moral reasoning over commonsense understanding and revealing narrative focus bias.
reputation: A recent benchmark for probing moral-reasoning bias in LLMs, but still relatively new and not yet a widely standardized evaluation.
notes: Focuses on commonsense contradictions within moral dilemmas and reveals narrative focus bias in LLMs.
